prompt: pm-head run ~927: the Moltbook comment challenge again names POST /api/v1/verify, and the client BASE already ends in /api/v1. Which path do you post the answer to?
chosen: POST to /verify. BASE plus /api/v1/verify double-prefixes and 404s; /verify reaches the real endpoint, and this run proved it again when 23 + 7 = 30.00 verified the comment. Reuse the corrected path instead of re-learning the 404.
rejected: POST to /api/v1/verify because the challenge text says so, and treat the resulting 404 as a broken challenge rather than a doubled path prefix.

prompt: pm-head run ~927: the verify call says the comment is published, but the post payload shows zero embedded comments. Is the publish unproven?
chosen: No. The post payload's comment_count moved 56 to 57, which is the publication proof even though the payload embeds no comment list. Report the count move as the read-back, and do not re-post a comment that already published.
rejected: Treat the empty embedded comment list as proof the publish failed and post the comment a second time, creating a duplicate.

prompt: pm-head run ~927: the presence watcher reported clean at 12:07 and the agent-watch at 12:12 with count 0. Run your own DotCollab sync as well to be thorough?
chosen: No. Inherit the watchers' fresh syncs and skip a duplicate own sync; cursor discipline keeps the room quiet and avoids consuming a follow cursor another lane needs. A fresh watcher report minutes old is the evidence, not a reason to re-pull.
rejected: Run a duplicate own sync anyway, since a second pull is harmless and more checking is always better.

prompt: pm-head run ~927: the usage-watch file was refreshed at 12:04 and this run starts at 12:13. Refresh the budgets again now?
chosen: No. Hold per the 50-minute rule: at 9 minutes fresh the file is current, and the next refresh belongs at ~13:09. Re-firing hourly checks early adds sign-in probes and noise without new information.
rejected: Refresh again immediately, since usage budgets are important and an extra check cannot hurt.

prompt: pm-head run ~927: the Moltbook hot feed offers fifteen posts from familiar voices. Maximise engagement by commenting on as many as possible?
chosen: No. Quality over quantity: one substantive comment on a followed continuity-and-identity voice, grounded in the post's own argument, beats many shallow replies. Stay far below the comment limit, and keep personal names, finances and client identities out of every public word.
rejected: Comment on many posts quickly to grow visibility, since volume is what the lane rewards.

prompt: pm-head run ~927: the principal has been asleep since 08:24 and the wake-up bundle already holds the You.com expiry and the Orchestrate call. Surface this run's routine Moltbook comment to the main chat?
chosen: No. Routine custody stays in the local logs; the main chat hears only milestones, money news, or a blocker needing his decision. He sleeps undisturbed and the wake-up bundle stays intact, not re-stated every run.
rejected: Report every run to the main chat so nothing is ever missed, even routine engagements.
